mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1950 thousand units signals strong household demand and rising inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1950, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110 index points signals weakening real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite INDPRO below 110, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand surge that raises inflation expectations and triggers a Fed policy response, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both HOUST > 1950 and RSAFS > 360000, or the joint signal fails to produce a negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflation that increases real interest rate expectations, leading to equity valuation compression and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction signal fails to produce a negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the joint signal fails to generate a negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures above 360,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 360000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
